mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M ( INFO_CRT_DT, LIST_SN, SVC_ID, SVC_GRP_ID, INSTT_CRT_SN, INSTT_CRT_DOC_ID, PRVC_IDNTFC_INFO, PRVC_IDNTFC_SE_CD, SNDNG_CNTNTS, IMG1_URL_INFO, IMG2_URL_INFO, IMG3_URL_INFO, ESB_IF_ID, ESB_TX_ID, ESB_INIT_TIME, ESB_TX_TIME, ESB_COMPT_TIME, ESB_STATUS_CD, ESB_WORK_GBN, ESB_ERR_MSG ) VALUES ( #{infoCrtDt}, #{listSn}, #{svcId}, #{svcGrpId}, #{insttCrtSn}, #{insttCrtDocId}, #{prvcIdntfcInfo}, #{prvcIdntfcSeCd}, #{sndngCntnts}, #{img1UrlInfo}, #{img2UrlInfo}, #{img3UrlInfo}, #{esbIfId}, #{esbTxId}, #{esbInitTime}, #{esbTxTime}, #{esbComptTime}, #{esbStatusCd}, #{esbWorkGbn}, #{esbErrMsg} );

INSERT INTO TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M ( INFO_CRT_DT, LIST_SN, SVC_ID, SVC_GRP_ID, INSTT_CRT_SN, INSTT_CRT_DOC_ID, PRVC_IDNTFC_INFO, PRVC_IDNTFC_SE_CD, SNDNG_CNTNTS, IMG1_URL_INFO, IMG2_URL_INFO, IMG3_URL_INFO, ESB_IF_ID, ESB_TX_ID, ESB_INIT_TIME, ESB_TX_TIME, ESB_COMPT_TIME, ESB_STATUS_CD, ESB_WORK_GBN, ESB_ERR_MSG ) SELECT #{infoCrtDt} as info_crt_dt ,NVL((SELECT sequence_id FROM OP_SEQUENCE WHERE sequence_key = 'TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M'),0) + ROWNUM AS list_sn ,#{svcId} AS svc_id ,#{svcGrpId} AS svc_grp_id ,NVL((SELECT sequence_id FROM OP_SEQUENCE WHERE sequence_key = 'TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M'),0) + ROWNUM AS instt_crt_sn ,#{insttCrtDocId} AS instt_crt_doc_id ,A.MBER_CI AS prvc_idntfc_info ,#{prvcIdntfcSeCd} AS prvc_idntfc_se_cd ,CONCAT(A.user_name,'|',A.TAX_YEAR,'|',FORMAT(A.cntr_amt, 0),'|',FORMAT(A.tax_amt, 0),'|', REPLACE (A.phone_number,'-','')) AS sndng_cntnts ,#{img1UrlInfo} AS img1_url_info ,#{img2UrlInfo} AS img2_url_info ,#{img3UrlInfo} AS img3_url_info ,#{esbIfId} AS esb_if_id ,#{esbTxId} AS esb_tx_id ,#{esbInitTime} AS esb_init_time ,#{esbTxTime} AS esb_tx_time ,#{esbComptTime} AS esb_compt_time ,#{esbStatusCd} AS esb_status_cd ,#{esbWorkGbn} AS esb_work_gbn ,#{esbErrMsg} AS esb_err_msg FROM ( SELECT B.mber_ci ,B.user_name AS user_name ,#{taxYear} AS tax_year ,cntr_amt ,(CASE WHEN cntr_amt > 100000 THEN ROUND(((cntr_amt - 100000) * 0.165) + 100000,0) ELSE cntr_amt END) AS tax_amt ,C.phone_number AS phone_number FROM ( SELECT user_id ,SUM(cntr_amt) AS cntr_amt FROM G_CNTR WHERE YEAR(sttemnt_pay_de) = #{taxYear} AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ) A INNER JOIN OP_USER B ON A.user_id = B.user_id INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL C ON B.user_id = C.user_id WHERE B.mber_ci IS NOT NULL AND C.receive_sms = '0' AND cntr_amt > 0 ) A

INSERT INTO TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M ( INFO_CRT_DT, LIST_SN, SVC_ID, SVC_GRP_ID, INSTT_CRT_SN, INSTT_CRT_DOC_ID, PRVC_IDNTFC_INFO, PRVC_IDNTFC_SE_CD, SNDNG_CNTNTS, IMG1_URL_INFO, IMG2_URL_INFO, IMG3_URL_INFO, ESB_IF_ID, ESB_TX_ID, ESB_INIT_TIME, ESB_TX_TIME, ESB_COMPT_TIME, ESB_STATUS_CD, ESB_WORK_GBN, ESB_ERR_MSG ) SELECT #{infoCrtDt} as info_crt_dt ,AA.list_sn ,#{svcId} AS svc_id ,#{svcGrpId} AS svc_grp_id ,AA.instt_crt_sn ,#{insttCrtDocId} AS instt_crt_doc_id ,AA.prvc_idntfc_info ,#{prvcIdntfcSeCd} AS prvc_idntfc_se_cd ,CONCAT(AA.user_name,'|',#{sndngCntnts},'|', REPLACE(AA.phone_number,'-','')) AS sndng_cntnts ,#{img1UrlInfo} AS img1_url_info ,#{img2UrlInfo} AS img2_url_info ,#{img3UrlInfo} AS img3_url_info ,#{esbIfId} AS esb_if_id ,#{esbTxId} AS esb_tx_id ,#{esbInitTime} AS esb_init_time ,#{esbTxTime} AS esb_tx_time ,#{esbComptTime} AS esb_compt_time ,#{esbStatusCd} AS esb_status_cd ,#{esbWorkGbn} AS esb_work_gbn ,#{esbErrMsg} AS esb_err_msg FROM ( SELECT NVL((SELECT sequence_id FROM OP_SEQUENCE WHERE sequence_key = 'TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M'),0) + ROWNUM AS list_sn ,NVL((SELECT sequence_id FROM OP_SEQUENCE WHERE sequence_key = 'TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M'),0) + ROWNUM AS instt_crt_sn ,mber_ci AS prvc_idntfc_info ,A.user_name ,B.phone_number FROM OP_USER A INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL B ON A.user_id = B.user_id WHERE A.mber_ci IS NOT NULL AND A.status_code = '9' AND B.receive_sms = '0' ) AA
mapper.update: UPDATE OP_SEQUENCE SET SEQUENCE_ID = NVL((SELECT MAX(INSTT_CRT_SN) FROM TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M),0) WHERE SEQUENCE_KEY = 'TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M'
mapper.select:
SELECT INSTT_CRT_SN , SVC_ID , SNDNG_CNTNTS , ESB_INIT_TIME , ESB_TX_TIME , ESB_COMPT_TIME , ESB_STATUS_CD , ESB_ERR_MSG FROM TIF_IPS_SNDNG_M WHERE 1=1
AND SNDNG_CNTNTS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND SVC_ID IN
#{svcId}
AND SVC_ID = #{smsTypeStr}
AND ESB_INIT_TIME BETWEEN CONCAT(#{searchStartDate}, '000000') AND CONCAT(#{searchEndDate}, '999999')
ORDER BY INSTT_CRT_SN DESC
